global_design_rules.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-6 to p-8 for containers)
global_design_rules.border_radius: Subtle roundness (rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for buttons)
global_design_rules.shadows: Diffuse ambient shadows for cards (shadow-sm), flat solid for tables
global_design_rules.backgrounds: bg-slate-50 for main content area to contrast with bright white cards

layout.split_layout: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 (Left info: col-span-4, Right timeline/resources: col-span-8)

cards.style: Neumorphism Tactile Variant - bg-white, border border-slate-200, shadow-sm, rounded-xl p-6

tables.style: Shadcn Table, border-collapse, text-sm, bg-white rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200
tables.headers: bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 uppercase text-xs tracking-wider py-4 px-6 text-left
tables.rows: border-t border-slate-200 py-4 px-6 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer

charts.bar_chart: Skill Gap Distribution. Use indigo-600 for bars, rounded top corners (radius=[4,4,0,0])
charts.pie_chart: Ready vs Not Ready. Use indigo-600 and slate-200. Donut style (innerRadius=60)

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors

drawer.style: w-[400px] sm:w-[540px] p-0 bg-white shadow-2xl border-l border-slate-200

progress_checklist.style: Shadcn Checkbox with label. Strike-through text and text-slate-400 on checked. Custom accent color indigo-600

filters.style: Shadcn Select or Command component for Student Insights filtering (Branch, Readiness %)

image_urls.description: Avatar for current logged-in student profile
Avatar for students in the TPO insights table
Company logo for announcements and grid cards

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'lucide-react' for minimal icons. Use them in both sidebars.
Install and configure 'recharts' via Shadcn for the TPO Dashboard bar and pie charts.
Use 'react-router-dom' to create a routing structure differentiating the TPO routes (/tpo/*) and Student routes (/student/*).
Build standard Dashboard Layouts with a fixed Left Sidebar and a main content area that scrolls independently.
TPO Sidebar is DARK (bg-slate-950) while Student Sidebar is LIGHT (bg-white) to visually separate the two roles.
TPO Sidebar Menu: Dashboard, Company Announcements, Student Insights, AI Reports, Shortlisted Candidates, Settings.
Student Sidebar Menu: Dashboard, Companies, My Roadmaps, Progress, Profile.
Implement the TPO Company Announcements Table: Clicking a row MUST open a Shadcn Sheet (drawer) containing details, students applied, and their readiness scores.
Implement the Student 'My Roadmaps' Page using a split layout (col-span-4 for selected company info, col-span-8 for Skill Gap, 14-Day Plan, Resources, Interview Prep sections).
Ensure the fonts (Outfit for Headings, IBM Plex Sans for body) are imported via Google Fonts in index.css or equivalent.
Apply 'data-testid' across all significant clickable components (e.g., 'data-testid="tpo-add-company-btn"').
